title: Figures 14-15: Electron shell bridges in ordinary explosives vs conjectured superexplosive
description: Two schematic diagrams in an appendix titled 'Conjectured Metastable Superexplosives Formed Under High Pressure for Thermonuclear Ignition'. 'Figure 14. Explosives.' contrasts an ordinary explosive (~1 Mb, heat released by eV photons) with a super-explosive (~100 Mb, X-rays released by keV photons) using paired atomic shell drawings. 'Figure 15. With Increasing Pressure, Electron Bridges are Formed Between Shells Inside Shells Melting into Common Shells' shows a pressure sequence emitting eV and keV photons.
